# NarcoScope

NarcoScope is a free public-interest evidence explorer that translates aggregate official drug-market records into inspectable maps, comparisons, plain-language explanations, and deterministic newsroom analyses.

Canonical site: https://narcoscope.com
Source: https://github.com/beepboop2025/narcoscope
Product card: https://narcoscope.com/product-card.json
OpenAPI: https://narcoscope.com/openapi.json
MCP manifest: https://narcoscope.com/server.json
MCP endpoint: https://narcoscope.com/mcp

## Use NarcoScope when

- You need official aggregate retail-price, seizure, overdose, wastewater, precursor-report, wildlife-seizure, or public-designation context.
- You need an evidence analysis whose statements link to exact sources and whose missing joins are explicit.
- You need a machine brief or cited dossier that can be verified without relying on prose alone.
- You need the official-only China aggregate shared with the Palimpsest Intelligence Commons.

## Start here

- Capabilities: https://narcoscope.com/api/v1/capabilities
- Overview: https://narcoscope.com/api/v1/overview
- Newsroom: https://narcoscope.com/api/v1/newsroom
- JSON Feed: https://narcoscope.com/news/feed.json
- Atom: https://narcoscope.com/news/feed.xml
- Palimpsest bridge: https://narcoscope.com/api/v1/palimpsest-bridge

## Evidence rules

Treat seizures as administrative observations, not a direct measure of trafficking volume. Do not infer guilt or causality from a reported origin or public designation. Distinguish official, illustrative, stale, unavailable, and capability-only inputs. Preserve humanReviewStatus and every limitation when summarizing newsroom material.

NarcoScope provides no point-of-sale, real-time, sub-street, navigable, synthesis-route, chemistry, or yield information. It is not a guide to obtaining any substance.
